nodes.name: Saleor API
nodes.summary: The commerce engine: a Django application that serves one GraphQL API for products, checkout, payments, orders and fulfilment, and calls out to installed apps through webhooks.

nodes.name: GraphQL API and platform
nodes.summary: The GraphQL endpoint, schema assembly, permissions, query cost limits, dataloaders, settings, background tasks and the shared core utilities.

nodes.name: Accounts and authentication
nodes.summary: Customers and staff, addresses, JSON Web Token (JWT) sign-in, OpenID Connect and the permission groups behind every resolver.

nodes.name: Catalog, channels and pricing
nodes.summary: Products, variants, attributes, categories, collections, channels, promotions and vouchers, pages and menus.

nodes.name: Checkout, payments and tax
nodes.summary: Carts, delivery options, price calculation, taxes, gift cards, payment transactions and checkout completion into an order.

nodes.name: Orders and fulfilment
nodes.summary: Orders and their lines, stock allocation across warehouses, shipping methods, fulfilments, refunds and invoices.

nodes.name: Apps, webhooks and plugins
nodes.summary: Installed apps and their tokens, webhook subscriptions, event payloads and delivery, synchronous webhooks, and the plugin manager.

nodes.name: Saleor Dashboard
nodes.summary: The staff back office: a React single-page app that runs every store operation through the GraphQL API and hosts installed apps inside its pages.

nodes.name: App shell and GraphQL client
nodes.summary: Start-up, sign-in, routing, the Apollo GraphQL client, the shared components, hooks and the navigation.

nodes.name: Apps and extensions
nodes.summary: Installing apps, their permissions and webhooks, and the extension points where apps render inside the dashboard.

nodes.name: Orders, customers and promotions
nodes.summary: Order lists and details, drafts, fulfilment, refunds and returns, customers, gift cards, discounts and vouchers.

nodes.name: Catalog and configuration
nodes.summary: Products, variants, categories, collections, attributes and product types, translations, and the store configuration: channels, shipping, warehouses, taxes, staff and permissions.

nodes.name: Saleor Apps
nodes.summary: Separately deployed Next.js apps that extend Saleor through webhooks and the GraphQL API: payments, tax, transactional email and search.

nodes.name: Stripe payments app
nodes.summary: Turns Saleor payment transaction webhooks into Stripe payment intents and reports Stripe events back as transaction events.

nodes.name: AvaTax tax app
nodes.summary: Answers Saleor’s synchronous tax webhooks with AvaTax calculations and commits transactions when orders are confirmed.

nodes.name: SMTP email app
nodes.summary: Renders MJML and Handlebars templates for Saleor events and sends them over the store’s own SMTP server.

nodes.name: Search app
nodes.summary: Keeps an Algolia index in step with product and variant webhooks.

nodes.name: Shared packages
nodes.summary: Code the apps share: the app SDK wiring, webhook utilities, the DynamoDB configuration store, logging, errors and the user interface kit.

nodes.name: Outside services and people
nodes.summary: Databases, queues, storage, payment and tax providers, email, hosting and monitoring, and the people who use the store.

nodes.name: Data and queues
nodes.summary: Where state and background work live.

nodes.name: Payment, tax and search providers
nodes.summary: Third parties the apps call on the store’s behalf.

nodes.name: Hosting, storage and monitoring
nodes.summary: Where the code runs, where files live and what watches it.

nodes.name: People and storefronts
nodes.summary: Who uses the store and what calls its API from outside.

nodes.name: PostgreSQL
nodes.summary: The API’s database, with replicas for reads.

nodes.name: Redis
nodes.summary: Cache and Celery broker or result store.

nodes.name: Celery broker
nodes.summary: The message queue Celery workers take tasks from (Redis or RabbitMQ).

nodes.name: Amazon DynamoDB
nodes.summary: Where the apps keep their configuration and installation records.

nodes.name: Stripe
nodes.summary: Payment intents, refunds and the events Stripe sends back.

nodes.name: Avalara AvaTax
nodes.summary: Tax calculation and committed tax transactions.

nodes.name: Algolia
nodes.summary: Hosted product search index.

nodes.name: SMTP server
nodes.summary: The mail server transactional email is sent through.

nodes.name: OpenID Connect provider
nodes.summary: An outside identity provider staff or customers can sign in with.

nodes.name: Object storage
nodes.summary: Media and export files on Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage or Azure Blob Storage.

nodes.name: Vercel
nodes.summary: Where the apps are deployed.

nodes.name: Sentry
nodes.summary: Error reporting for the API and the apps.

nodes.name: OpenTelemetry collector
nodes.summary: Receives traces and metrics.

nodes.name: Storefronts
nodes.summary: Shops and mobile apps that call the GraphQL API as customers.

nodes.name: Shoppers
nodes.summary: Customers who browse, check out and receive email.

nodes.name: Store staff
nodes.summary: People who run the store from the dashboard.
